pages.title: The limits of the reduction
pages.text:
The limits of the reduction
The calculation assumes a long straight channel, ﬁxed viscosity and fully developed ﬂow.
It does not solve an entrance region, moving curved boundaries or general
pressure–velocity coupling.
Computational Cardiology Notes 18 / 18
